name: musical-scales
description: Interactive Circle of Fifths, scales, and chord voicing explorer for piano, guitar, violin, and cello

scripts.build: bun run ingest-songs && bun check -b && rm -rf dist/client && bun build ./index.html --outdir=dist/client --production --splitting --public-path=/ --asset-naming=assets/[name]-[hash].[ext] --chunk-naming=assets/[name]-[hash].[ext] && cp public/_headers dist/client/_headers
